messages:
Alex: FYI — starting 11:02 UTC we're seeing a sharp rise in us-east GPU queues. Appears tied to a burst of long-context generation and increased cross-region egress.

Jin: Looks real on our side. `region=us-east queue_length` jumped 90 -> 610 in ~12m. p95 latency up ~2x. `sum(rate(requests[1m])) by (region,model)` shows heavy concentration on `rtx-a100-70b`.

ops-bot: Alert: provider-egress-throttle(us-east) triggered at 2026-03-18T11:04:02Z. Threshold: egress_utilization > 90%. Notifying oncall.

Sam: If egress is saturated, spilling more traffic to eu only amplifies egress load. Can we pause cross-region spillover for non-critical tiers?

Maria: Proposal: (1) disable cross-region spill for free/standard tenants, (2) enable model fallback to quantized variants for best-effort traffic, (3) drop concurrency cap by 30% for top bursty tenants for 15m.

Jin: Draft admission change:
```
route_policy:
  concurrency_multiplier: 0.7
  allow_cross_region_spill: false   # apply if billing.tier != enterprise
  fallback_sequence:
    - model: rv1-vq2
    - model: rv1-small
```
Can canary to 10% of us-east shards.

Alex: Good. Need quick SLA classification (billing.tier exists) and a metric to auto-toggle the policy (cross-region-egress ratio).

Jin: We can reuse `billing.tier`. I'll add `cross_region_egress_ratio = egress_bytes_cross_region / egress_bytes_total` to routing dashboards and create an alert at 0.12.

Sam: Ops playbook: rollout canary -> monitor p50/p95 and cross-region ratio -> if p95 improves and eu queues don't spike, scale canary. Leave enterprise untouched.

Maria: Cost impact note: local fallbacks will increase compute time on smaller GPUs but cut egress spend. Rough estimate: +7-10% compute, -20-25% egress for affected tenants. I'll attach a short delta after lunch.

Jin: Quick config diff we can push via ops-config:
```
- allow_spillover: true
+ allow_spillover: false
  spillover_exceptions:
    - tag: billing.tier=enterprise
```

Alex: Running canary at 11:40 UTC. @Oncall please monitor. If enterprise p95 regresses >15% we rollback ASAP.

ops-bot: Deploy started by Alex at 2026-03-18T11:40:02Z 1 job id: deploy-5891

Jin: Canary update (+12m): us-east queue dropped from 610 -> 205, p95 down ~36%. EU ingress due to earlier spill dropped ~20%. Enterprise metrics stable.

Maria: Nice. Next steps: automate the switch based on cross_region_egress_ratio with a 5m cooldown to avoid flapping. Also add a circuit breaker metric: attempts_to_spill / successful_spill.

Sam: Adding cooldown and circuit-breaker to dashboard now. Will add a short windowed smoothing to the ratio so transient spikes don't flip the rule.

Alex: Action items: 1) create cross-region egress ratio alert, 2) default routing to be SLA-aware (no spill for non-enterprise during caps), 3) tabletop for multi-region egress caps and provider limits. Please file tickets.

Jin: Tickets opened: INF-3301 (egress ratio alert), INF-3302 (SLA-aware routing defaults), INF-3303 (egress tabletop exercise).

Maria: :thumbsup: Closing loop here. Will circulate cost delta and a short runbook update for oncall.

ops-bot: Thread closed by ops-bot at 2026-03-18T12:05:08Z
